title: Sky Blue: Understanding Your Free Period
summary: Explains Sky Blue’s “free period” for 6 months: monthly maintenance fees are waived while account features continue normally. The free period starts at account opening, ends after 6 months, then the monthly maintenance fee becomes $25.00 automatically.
